notes: A game-discovery experience whose purpose is sending visitors onward to other games is Entertainment's Hub, and hub-portals is the shape that says exactly that. The P4 stays: the genre's exception routes a hub to P0 only when its portals lead to genuinely separate Roblox places, and the answers chose the opposite — six portals opening into zones of this same build, which the pipeline treats as real zone transitions. teleporter-link is the six portals, social-hub the plaza floor they ring, and landmark-focal the central structure that makes a compact futuristic plaza readable from anywhere in it. With no user to ask I sized the hub itself as the one walkable space rather than a district, per the scale answer, and left the six destination zones as the thing the portals hand off to rather than trying to lay them out here.
